title: [Bugfix] Fix Phi-3 BNB quantization with tensor parallel
reported_gain: N/A (correctness bugfix: makes Phi-3 BNB quantization work with tensor parallel; the quoted ~28.7 tok/s is the fixed model simply running, not a speedup over any working baseline)
note: Diff generalizes adjust_bitsandbytes_4bit_shard (renames qkv_offsets->shard_offsets) and adds fused-on-disk BNB weight sharding in linear.py + loader.py so QKV/MergedColumn fused BNB weights shard correctly under tensor parallel. This is a CORRECTNESS bugfix (FIX #9937) enabling Phi-3.5-mini BNB with TP=2, not a performance optimization. The index's '0.8%, 0.0%' derives from the author's TP=2 demo log (Avg generation throughput ~28.7 tok/s) which merely shows the previously-broken configuration now running; there is no before/after speedup baseline, so no timing experiment applies.
environment: reported-only: author's published numbers; measured arms pending on GPU box
